news.title: 面向OEM产品开发的Edge AI硬件
news.snippet: [Simms介绍Edge AI硬件如何助力OEM厂商在产品开发中实现智能化。]
news.raw_snippet:
Artificial intelligence is creating new opportunities for Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) to develop smarter, more capable products. From autonomous robotics and industrial machinery to intelligent monitoring equipment, the ability to process and act on data locally is becoming an increasingly valuable product feature. [...] However, incorporating AI into a product introduces new challenges. Hardware must deliver the required processing performance while meeting constraints around power consumption, physical dimensions, connectivity and long-term availability.

For OEMs, the challenge isn't simply finding a processor capable of running AI. It's selecting a dependable hardware platform that supports product development today and commercial deployment tomorrow. [...] ## The Challenge: Moving from AI Concept to Commercial Product

Developing an AI-enabled product involves more than integrating a model or algorithm.

OEM engineering teams must consider how computing hardware fits into the wider product design, how it communicates with sensors and other components, and whether it can operate reliably in its intended environment.

Several considerations can influence the success of an AI product:
